annotations.title: No Surprises Act IDR: rank the arbitrators for a cell

description: For a CPT/HCPCS code, payer and state, every certified IDR entity that decided that cell in the CMS 2025 Q4 file, ranked by provider loss rate, with determinations, median winning multiple, 2026 single-determination fee, expected fee cost (fee x loss rate), certification status and the gap to the cell's overall loss rate. The initiating party proposes the entity and the other side has 3 business days to object. Free when the cell has under 50 determinations or with preview=true; otherwise with a Tensorust enterprise key. Data only.
